module_summary: AXI-Stream crossbar switch: per-input register slices decode tdest into a latched output select, per-output arbiters grant one input per frame and mux its stream into an output register slice.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].select_reg
anchors.why: Per-input decoded destination port steering valid and ready routing for the frame

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].select_valid_reg
anchors.why: Route decoded for current frame; held until tlast, gates forwarded valid

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].drop_reg
anchors.why: Drops frames with unmatched tdest by forcing ready and masking valid

anchors.name: int_s_axis_tdest
anchors.why: Registered input tdest decoded into output port select

anchors.name: int_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input-to-output valid matrix feeding arbiter requests and output mux

anchors.name: int_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output-to-input ready matrix returned to granted input

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector from inputs targeting this output

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases arbiter grant at end of granted frame

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant selecting which input stream is muxed to this output

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid gating mux valid and ready

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].m_axis_tdata_mux
anchors.why: Selected input data driving output register slice

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].m_axis_tvalid_mux
anchors.why: Selected valid into output register slice

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].m_axis_tlast_mux
anchors.why: Selected tlast used to acknowledge arbiter at frame end

anchors.name: s_axis_tdest
anchors.why: Destination routing field of input streams

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
